title: Polyhedral norms and smooth Hahn-Banach extension
author: Saikat Roy
work: Polyhedral norms and smooth Hahn-Banach extension
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's theorem (smooth HB liftings) (source0.tex lines 103-105, source label smooth HB liftings). The statement reads: theorem smooth HB liftings Let X be a polyhedral space and Y be a subspace of it. Then any smooth functional f on Y extends to a norm-preserving smooth functional f on X if and only if f attains its absolute norm at an extreme point of B Y which is also an ext. The retained complete proof (lines 175-293, 119 lines, which the article places away from the statement) is the article's own argument, retained line for line. It is a research-level argument in this field: it is not a routine verification but a complete proof whose steps (case analysis, intermediate estimates, comparison or induction arguments as the source words them) must all be carried out before the statement follows, which places it above ordinary PhD qualifying exercises, where such results are quoted rather than proved.
